typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Outfit for all Headings (H1-H6) as Space Grotesk is forbidden for dashboards per E1 rules. Use Manrope for standard body text. Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for data cells, metrics, IP addresses, logs, code, and SSH terminal. Apply tight tracking to headings (tracking-tight) and uppercase wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for small labels.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use `Space Grotesk` font (strictly banned by E1 for dashboards), instead use `Outfit` for headings to maintain a premium geometric tech look. Body must be `Manrope` and data/metrics MUST be `JetBrains Mono`.
Ensure all data grids, tables, metrics, terminals, and IPs use the `.font-mono` class mapping to JetBrains Mono.
For .js / .jsx usage ONLY. Do not output .tsx files.
Cards and panels MUST use the soft-rounded (rounded-xl) glass aesthetic, while ALL form inputs, textareas, and buttons MUST use sharp/near-sharp edges (rounded-sm) to create a premium contrast.
Apply generous padding (p-6 or p-8) inside `.rounded-xl` cards, while maintaining compact dashboard structures for data-heavy sections.
Use 1px border-white/10 everywhere to create defined surface edges against the dark background. Do not rely solely on shadows in dark mode.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Never use a fully transparent header over scrolling content. Always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent background color like bg-[#0B0C10]/80.
Add subtle glow to status dots and active primary buttons using shadow utilities.
Use Recharts for all dashboard charts applying the specific vivid accent stroke colors defined.
Use Sonner for toast notifications. Ensure toast container matches the dark glass theme.
